i.norm: Verifies that {@link StringTokenizer} correctly parses a semicolon-separated string that exercises quoting, escaped quotes and empty fields.

Input fields (separated by ';'): a -> "a" b -> "b" c -> "c " (trailing space kept; the default tokenizer does not trim) "d;""e" -> "d;\"e" (quoted, so the ';' is data and "" is an escaped quote) f -> "f" (space) -> " " (space) -> " " (empty) -> "" (trailing delimiter yields a final empty token)
